title: Neon Rush
description: Sprint through a futuristic cyberpunk metropolis at lightning velocity! Switch lanes, jump laser barriers, slide under plasma gates, and collect neon coins as speed ramps up indefinitely.
instructions: Switch between 3 runner lanes to avoid oncoming obstacles.
Jump over ground barriers and spiked barriers.
Slide beneath overhead electric energy gates.
Collect neon energy coins to boost your multiplier and score.
controls: Arrow Left / Right / Swipe Left-Right: Switch lanes
Arrow Up / Space / Swipe Up: Jump
